content/provenance/numbers.json.contract: Every structured balance number in these canonical documents is a hypothesis until a tracked study receipt explicitly replaces its status.

content/game/content-manifest.json.purpose: Inventory every physical and thematic text surface without confusing draft copy for proven balance.

surfaceContract.mechanics: This manifest inventories executable game ${game.executableVersion} and synchronized physical candidate ${game.rulesVersion}. Both project from the same semantic game graph.
surfaceContract.theme: Flavor text, institutional framing, and art direction may intensify tone but cannot silently alter mechanics.

abilityTimingContract.unlocks: An ability unlocks at the start of its named round.
abilityTimingContract.persistence: persistsAfterUnlock states whether the ability remains available after its named round.

scale.meaning: Relative institutional identity, not a point-buy budget or a promise of equal raw resources.

dimensions.capitalAccess: Ability to obtain and sustain Runway.
dimensions.computeAccess: Privileged access to training and inference capacity.
dimensions.researchReliability: Ability to turn Research attempts into dependable Capability.
dimensions.distribution: Ability to reach Customers and markets.
dimensions.infrastructureVelocity: Ability to build, move, and operate physical infrastructure.
dimensions.institutionalTrust: Ability to accumulate legitimacy and withstand governance pressure.
dimensions.coalitionLeverage: Ability to make mutually useful deals and shape other players' incentives.

factionTruthContract.eligibilityRule: Balance conversion, exposure, timing, rigidity, and dependency around faction truth. A candidate is ineligible if it removes the faction's protected strength, even when it improves parity.

coalition_lab.balanceBottleneck: Dependence on willing partners and terms that remain individually rational.
coalition_lab.forbiddenCorrection: Do not make solo resource conversion more reliable than negotiated play.

platform_empire.protectedStrength: Installed Customers, distribution, and market reach.
platform_empire.balanceBottleneck: Trust, exposure, and escalating consequences from deployment.
platform_empire.forbiddenCorrection: Do not make the platform bad at reaching or monetizing Customers.

imperial_research_lab.protectedStrength: Compute access, Research reliability, and Capability generation.
imperial_research_lab.balanceBottleneck: Public validation, commercialization, and claim timing.
imperial_research_lab.forbiddenCorrection: Do not make successful scientific rigor reduce Capability or make the institution compute-poor.

vertical_empire.protectedStrength: Infrastructure velocity, capital, and physical mobility.
vertical_empire.balanceBottleneck: Scrutiny, strategic rigidity, and political legitimacy.
vertical_empire.forbiddenCorrection: Do not make the institution slow at constructing or relocating infrastructure.

safety_laboratory.balanceBottleneck: Slower expansion and fewer aggressive conversions.
safety_laboratory.forbiddenCorrection: Do not make caution, Safety, or Trust a losing resource in itself.

foundry.balanceBottleneck: Opponent-count scaling and dependence on other institutions spending Compute.
foundry.forbiddenCorrection: Do not make the supplier compute-poor or indifferent to rivals' demand.

factions.name: ${terms.factions.coalition}
factions.motto: Alignment begins with the term sheet.
factions.publicPromise: Coordinate capital, talent, and institutions around a shared frontier.
factions.privateAnxiety: Every alliance contains the next board meeting.
factions.introduction: ${terms.factions.coalition} brokers a continuously renegotiated coalition that keeps building by making rivals, patrons, and regulators feel briefly indispensable.
factions.victoryStatement: A durable coalition has recognized our definition of the future.
factions.artDirection: Diplomatic research campus built around a circular boardroom, with temporary bridges connecting every wing.

abilities.name: Deal Flow
abilities.text: Once per round after an immediate trade in which you give at least 1 resource and receive a different resource type, gain 1 ${terms.resources.runway}. ${terms.resources.runway}, ${terms.resources.compute}, and ${terms.resources.safety} are different resource types; exchanging the same type does not trigger Deal Flow.
abilities.flavorText: Every solved disagreement reveals an investable relationship.
abilities.artDirection: A handshake emitting a clean stream of capital into a laboratory.

abilities.name: Board Reshuffle
abilities.text: Once during ${terms.eras.scale}, after ${terms.actions.organize}, ready 1 different Core Action and add 1 ${terms.resources.scrutiny}.
abilities.flavorText: Leadership continuity has been restored around a substantially different leadership structure.
abilities.artDirection: Boardroom chairs rearranging themselves around an unchanged glowing mission statement.

abilities.name: Strategic Partnership
abilities.text: Joint Ventures may be formed with a player within 2 hexes. They remain active at that range while both host Facilities are connected and powered.
abilities.flavorText: Adjacency is a technical limitation. Strategic necessity is not.
abilities.artDirection: A ceremonial bridge spanning two hexes that do not physically touch.

abilities.name: Wildcard Governance
abilities.text: Once per game, immediately after a ${terms.systems.headline} is revealed but before its instructions resolve, discard it, reveal 2 replacements from the current Era deck, and choose 1 to resolve and enter the ${terms.systems.futureTimeline}. Return the other replacement to the box and add 2 ${terms.resources.scrutiny}.
abilities.flavorText: The situation is unchanged. The available interpretations have improved.
abilities.artDirection: A crisis headline removed from a broadcast wall and replaced with two polished alternatives.

factions.name: ${terms.factions.platform}
factions.publicPromise: Deliver open intelligence at planetary consumer scale.
factions.privateAnxiety: A platform is only permanent until the next interface.
factions.introduction: ${terms.factions.platform} begins with distribution others must build toward. He can rearrange an enormous institution, open what helps it expand, and treat controlled markets as extensions of his own interface.
factions.victoryStatement: General intelligence is now enabled by default.
factions.artDirection: A vast social campus shaped like a friendly public square whose paths all terminate at one control room.

abilities.name: Installed Base
abilities.text: The first ${terms.actions.deploy} each round on Consumer or Media costs no ${terms.resources.compute}.
abilities.flavorText: Distribution is free once the public has nowhere else to log in.
abilities.artDirection: Millions of household screens illuminating at the same quiet moment.

abilities.name: Year of Efficiency
abilities.text: Once during ${terms.eras.scale}, while resolving ${terms.actions.organize}, return 1 deployed Team before resolving the selected mode. Gain 3 ${terms.resources.runway} and move every remaining CEO, Team, and Expert 1 hex. The returned Team cannot be recruited during this action.
abilities.flavorText: The institution becomes smaller, faster, and mysteriously farther across the map.
abilities.artDirection: An enormous org chart compressing into a sharp arrow while desks vanish below.

abilities.name: Open Ecosystem
abilities.text: When using Open Weights, gain 1 additional ${terms.resources.trust} and 1 Market Access token.
abilities.flavorText: The gates open outward into an ecosystem whose roads all lead home.
abilities.artDirection: Weights pouring freely through an open arch into a landscape of platform-branded paths.

abilities.name: The Social Graph
abilities.text: Once per round during ${terms.actions.deploy}, choose any controlled Consumer or Media hex as the destination without moving there. That remote tile supplies its normal visit bonus and every destination-dependent ${terms.actions.deploy} effect.
abilities.flavorText: Physical distance is a legacy setting.
abilities.artDirection: A central institution reaching a distant market through a dense web of human connections.

factions.name: ${terms.factions.imperial}
factions.motto: First understand intelligence. Then invoice the infrastructure.
factions.publicPromise: Advance science through general systems grounded in rigorous evaluation.
factions.privateAnxiety: The parent institution can fund anything except patience.
factions.introduction: ${terms.factions.imperial} treats the race as a scientific program backed by an empire he does not entirely command. His experiments are unusually controlled until the moonshot requires real estate.
factions.victoryStatement: The result exceeds every benchmark we still recognize.
factions.artDirection: A contemplative research citadel beneath the shadow of a much larger cloud-and-capital superstructure.

scoringRule.name: Peer Validation
scoringRule.text: ${terms.resources.capability} ${facts.shared.factions.imperial.peerValidation.lateFromCapability} and ${facts.shared.factions.imperial.peerValidation.fullValidationCapability} score ${facts.shared.factions.imperial.peerValidation.baseMandate} ${terms.resources.mandate}. In a five-player game, ${terms.resources.capability} ${facts.shared.factions.imperial.peerValidation.fullValidationCapability} instead scores ${facts.shared.factions.imperial.peerValidation.fullMandate} ${terms.resources.mandate}.
scoringRule.flavorText: Four independent rivals transform an internal result into public history.
scoringRule.artDirection: A sealed research result crossing four independent institutional desks before entering the historical record.

abilities.name: Scientific Method
abilities.text: Once per round, when a protectable duplicate would crash your ${terms.systems.trainingRun}, pay 1 ${terms.resources.runway} to discard it and immediately bank. This cannot protect the unprotectable duplicate created by Synthetic Loop.
abilities.flavorText: A failed run becomes a controlled negative result when recorded by the correct institution.
abilities.artDirection: A duplicate data card calmly filed into a cabinet labeled REPLICATION.

abilities.name: Call Mountain View
abilities.text: At the beginning of ${terms.eras.scale} before its first ${terms.systems.headline}, choose 1: gain 3 ${terms.resources.runway}; examine and reorder the top 4 Training cards; or gain 3 ${terms.resources.compute}.
abilities.flavorText: The empire answers through capital, architecture, or a sudden fleet of accelerators.
abilities.artDirection: Three monumental channels descending from a cloud: currency, research diagrams, and processors.

abilities.name: Nobel Effect
abilities.text: Completing a 5-domain ${terms.systems.trainingRun} gains 2 ${terms.resources.trust}.
abilities.flavorText: Recognition radiates outward, temporarily improving every adjacent claim.
abilities.artDirection: A medal casting a protective golden field around a training facility.

abilities.name: Scaling-Law Breakthrough
abilities.text: Once per game when resolving ${terms.actions.research}, each of the first 3 distinct domains banked grants 1 additional ${terms.resources.capability}. Add 2 ${terms.resources.scrutiny}. No additional Action resolves.
abilities.flavorText: The experiment requires a campus before the hypothesis has finished resolving.
abilities.artDirection: A scientific diagram extruding directly into a colossal construction site.

factions.name: ${terms.factions.vertical}
factions.motto: If it can be announced, it can be industrialized.
factions.publicPromise: Compress the path from first principle to planetary infrastructure.
factions.privateAnxiety: Polarization is cheap until ${terms.resources.trust} becomes a requirement.
factions.introduction: ${terms.factions.vertical} treats supply chains, platforms, launch systems, and public attention as one machine. He moves rapidly, builds visibly, and considers terrestrial constraints an invitation to relocate the constraint.
factions.victoryStatement: The future is operational and moving at launch velocity.
factions.artDirection: A severe industrial complex joining factories, rockets, energy systems, and a broadcast tower along one vertical axis.

abilities.name: Industrial Velocity
abilities.text: Your first Facility ${terms.actions.build} each round costs 1 less ${terms.resources.runway}. When that discount actually reduces the ${terms.resources.runway} paid for a completed Facility, score ${facts.shared.factions.vertical.industrialVelocityMandate} ${terms.resources.mandate}.
abilities.flavorText: The concrete cures while the permit learns to keep up.
abilities.artDirection: A powered facility already operating behind an arriving ribbon-cutting committee.

abilities.name: Move Fast
abilities.displayName: The Roadmap Is a Launch Window
abilities.text: Before resolving any action, the CEO may move up to 3 hexes instead of 2. This does not grant a free ${terms.actions.build}.
abilities.flavorText: Distance is reduced through urgency and a highly motivated logistics department.
abilities.artDirection: An executive piece crossing three hexes on the trajectory of a launch vehicle.

abilities.name: Own the Feed
abilities.text: Once during ${terms.eras.narrative}, after a 2-outcome ${terms.systems.headline} resolves, choose which result applies to you personally. This does not change the global result, another player’s result, a Government vote, or a persistent ${terms.systems.headline} outcome.
abilities.flavorText: Volatility remains random for organizations without distribution.
abilities.artDirection: A two-sided news event passing through a private control panel and emerging as one chosen version.

abilities.name: Orbital ${terms.resources.compute}
abilities.text: Once per game during your movement step, instead of moving the acting piece, move 1 Facility to any legal open Facility space. It carries every attached component and designation. Recalculate its Network; if current connected capacity can satisfy its full demand, immediately resolve its printed production once. Add 2 ${terms.resources.scrutiny}.
abilities.flavorText: The cooling plan is mostly night.
abilities.artDirection: A complete data center rising from the map toward an orbital transfer platform.

factions.name: ${terms.factions.safety}
factions.motto: Scale only after naming the scale.
factions.publicPromise: ${terms.actions.build} powerful systems inside explicit, enforceable safety boundaries.
factions.privateAnxiety: A boundary nobody crosses may be indistinguishable from losing.
factions.introduction: ${terms.factions.safety} turns caution into a competitive asset. He can stabilize ${terms.actions.research}, audit Deployments, and sell rivals the restraint they failed to budget for.
factions.victoryStatement: The threshold was crossed within the approved framework.
factions.artDirection: A fortified research campus of layered transparent safeguards surrounding a bright, slightly too large model core.

abilities.name: Constitutional Training
abilities.text: ${terms.resources.safety}-token limit is 4.
abilities.flavorText: The system may be unpredictable, but its unpredictability has enumerated rights and duties.
abilities.artDirection: A model core encircled by a formal illuminated charter.

abilities.name: Responsible Scaling
abilities.text: Once during ${terms.eras.scale}, when a rival reveals a protectable duplicate that would crash their ${terms.systems.trainingRun}, you may offer 1 ${terms.resources.safety} for 1 ${terms.resources.runway}. If accepted, the rival pays, discards the duplicate, receives and immediately spends the ${terms.resources.safety}, and banks; you gain 1 ${terms.resources.trust}. If declined, transfer nothing and gain no ${terms.resources.trust}.
abilities.flavorText: The industry has discovered a market for not making the same mistake twice.
abilities.artDirection: A safety token transferred across a table beside a modest invoice.

abilities.name: Audited Deployment
abilities.text: The first ${terms.actions.deploy} each round adds no ${terms.resources.scrutiny}.
abilities.flavorText: Every consequence has been assigned a section number.
abilities.artDirection: A deployment vessel wrapped in transparent annotations and compliance marks.

abilities.name: Emergency Pause
abilities.text: Once per game before Action selection begins, pay 1 ${terms.resources.runway} and name 1 globally unlocked ${terms.systems.wildAction}. It cannot be selected this cycle. Gain 2 ${terms.resources.trust}. This cannot be declared after any player has selected an Action.
abilities.flavorText: For one brief cycle, not acting becomes the most visible action at the table.
abilities.artDirection: A monumental pause control descending between the board and an advancing agent swarm.

factions.name: ${terms.factions.foundry}
factions.motto: Every future requires an allocation window.
factions.publicPromise: Provide the architecture on which every institution can build.
factions.privateAnxiety: ${terms.resources.customers} may eventually remember they are also competitors.
factions.introduction: ${terms.factions.foundry} sells the race to every racer. He profits from demand, allocates scarcity, and occasionally advances the entire table to ensure the next architecture has a market.
factions.victoryStatement: Whatever intelligence is, it has entered volume production.
factions.artDirection: A golden-black semiconductor foundry at the center of roads leading to every rival institution.

abilities.name: The Shovels
abilities.text: When another player spends at least 2 ${terms.resources.compute} in 1 action, gain 1 ${terms.resources.runway}, at most ${facts.shared.factions.foundry.shovelsPerRound} times per round.
abilities.flavorText: Every breakthrough arrives with a purchase order.
abilities.artDirection: A rival launch reflected in ${terms.factions.foundry}’s steadily rising order ledger.

abilities.name: Allocation Window
abilities.text: Once during ${terms.eras.scale}, after a ${terms.systems.headline} resolves but before Action selection, create 2 temporary ${terms.resources.compute} and offer it to rivals at negotiated prices. All temporary ${terms.resources.compute} remaining anywhere at cycle end disappears, sold or unsold.
abilities.flavorText: Scarcity has been suspended for customers with sufficiently immediate decisions.
abilities.artDirection: Two brilliant processor crates auctioned beneath a closing allocation clock.

abilities.name: New Architecture
abilities.text: At the beginning of ${terms.eras.narrative} before its first ${terms.systems.headline}, each rival may pay you 1 ${terms.resources.runway} to gain 1 ${terms.resources.compute}. Gain ${facts.shared.factions.foundry.newArchitectureDemandCoupling.computePerLicense} ${terms.resources.compute} per rival who pays, maximum ${facts.shared.factions.foundry.newArchitectureDemandCoupling.maximumCompute}; automatic base gain: ${facts.shared.factions.foundry.newArchitectureDemandCoupling.baseCompute}.
abilities.flavorText: The old architecture remains supported until the end of the sentence.
abilities.artDirection: A new processor geometry unfolding while rival institutions queue beneath a one-cycle licensing window.

abilities.name: Everybody Gets a GPU
abilities.text: Once per game before Action selection in any Round IV cycle, give every rival 1 ${terms.resources.compute} from the bank, score 1 ${terms.resources.mandate} per ${facts.shared.factions.foundry.everybodyGpuRivalsPerMandate} rivals, and remove 2 ${terms.resources.scrutiny}.
abilities.flavorText: Industry peace is achieved by ensuring everyone requires the next shipment.
abilities.artDirection: A ceremonial distribution of glowing accelerators to six visibly suspicious institutions.

theme.tone: Solemn institutions normalize increasingly absurd technology.
theme.escalationRule: Each Era should feel one step less reasonable while every rule remains plainly legible.
theme.tablePromise: ${terms.actions.build} the future, power it, negotiate ownership of it, and announce it before anyone can define it.

tieRule.text: When lowest, highest, or most is tied, the tied player nearest Initiative clockwise is the target unless the effect explicitly applies to everyone.

audit.overflowPenalty: For each ${terms.resources.scrutiny} cube that cannot be added, immediately pay 1 ${terms.resources.runway} or lose 1 ${terms.resources.trust}.

rounds.name: ${terms.eras.demo}
rounds.tagline: Nobody knows whether it works. Everyone knows the valuation.
rounds.flavorText: A small prototype becomes a civilizational talking point before lunch.
rounds.artDirection: A single glowing terminal on a severe stage facing an impossibly large audience.

rounds.name: ${terms.eras.scale}
rounds.tagline: The model is no longer the product. Electricity, land, and patience are the product.
rounds.flavorText: ${terms.actions.research} leaves the laboratory and begins negotiating directly with the power grid.
rounds.artDirection: A data-center campus spreading across a valley beneath tasteful planning banners.
newThisEra: Links and the Network production bonus

rounds.name: ${terms.eras.narrative}
rounds.tagline: ${terms.resources.capability} exists. Reality must now be informed.
rounds.flavorText: Every institution reaches the same independent conclusion through different sponsored channels.
rounds.artDirection: Media, government, and capital towers converging into one serene broadcast face.

rounds.name: ${terms.eras.claim}
rounds.tagline: General intelligence has become a financing category.
rounds.flavorText: Agent swarms, orbital facilities, and fusion announcements enter the ordinary quarterly calendar.
rounds.artDirection: A press podium beneath orbital compute and a reactor sunrise.

actions.name: ${terms.actions.fund}
actions.slogan: The forecast contains no revenue, only destiny.
actions.flavorText: Convert urgency, access, and a favorable chart into additional institutional life.
actions.artDirection: A capital terminal printing a runway directly toward the horizon.

actions.name: ${terms.actions.research}
actions.slogan: Every domain is signal until it appears twice.
actions.flavorText: Feed the model distinct portions of civilization and decide when confidence becomes evidence.
actions.artDirection: Seven data streams entering a restrained black training chamber.

actions.name: ${terms.actions.build}
actions.summary: Construct a Facility or Generator, or install a Link.
actions.flavorText: Turn architecture slides into facilities, generators, Networks, and permanent local weather.
actions.artDirection: An immaculate blueprint unfolding into a monumental powered campus.

actions.name: ${terms.actions.organize}
actions.summary: Recruit, redistribute Teams, or relocate a Facility.
actions.slogan: People are our greatest configurable resource.
actions.flavorText: Move the people, rename the divisions, and describe the disappearance of a Team as focus.
actions.artDirection: An org chart transforming into moving pieces across the hex map.

actions.name: ${terms.actions.deploy}
actions.summary: Spend 1 ${terms.resources.compute} to gain a ${terms.resources.customer} if ${terms.resources.capability} permits.
actions.slogan: Production is the final evaluation environment.
actions.flavorText: Convert ${terms.resources.capability} into dependency, recurring revenue, and attention that marketing cannot entirely absorb.
actions.artDirection: A polished launch button connected to hospitals, markets, homes, and one unknown system.

actions.name: ${terms.actions.influence}
actions.slogan: Stakeholders have independently aligned with the briefing.
actions.flavorText: Move opinion through media, government, and capital until institutional preference resembles public reality.
actions.artDirection: A quiet briefing radiating outward into identical spontaneous headlines.

runway.name: ${terms.resources.runway}
runway.microcopy: Time, money, and permission to continue.

compute.name: ${terms.resources.compute}
compute.iconConcept: A processor containing a grid symbol.

capability.name: ${terms.resources.capability}
capability.microcopy: What the model can do before anyone agrees what it means.
capability.iconConcept: A stepped waveform entering an eye.

customers.name: ${terms.resources.customers}
customers.iconConcept: A user silhouette inside a contract seal.

trust.name: ${terms.resources.trust}
trust.microcopy: Public permission with a short half-life.
trust.iconConcept: A civic column built from signal bars.

safety.name: ${terms.resources.safety}
safety.microcopy: One more chance to stop while stopping is still an option.
safety.iconConcept: A shield containing a pause mark.

board.prototypeNote: Selected sixfold-symmetric board: 1 center, 6 operational-ring, and 6 evenly spaced public-ring hexes.

geometry.placementRule: Shuffle each ring pool independently. ${terms.locations.frontier} remains fixed at center.

realignment.name: ${terms.systems.realignment}
realignment.timing: Exactly once, after ${terms.resources.mandate} scoring in Round III.
realignment.vote: Every player secretly selects one motion. Reveal simultaneously. The motion with the most ballots resolves.
realignment.tieBreak: Among tied leading motions, scan players clockwise from Initiative; the first ballot naming a tied motion selects it.
realignment.contentsRule: Location tiles and everything on them move together. ${terms.locations.frontier} never moves.
realignment.networkRule: After movement, recalculate Network reach from the starting-grid Facility, Generators, Link-marked Facilities, and visible adjacency. No pieces are lifted or re-laid.
realignment.agreementRule: Joint Ventures and Mega-Clusters remain owned but produce only while their required Facilities are adjacent. Immediate ${terms.resources.power} purchases never persist through Realignment.

motions.name: Consolidate the Core
motions.ballotText: Rotate the six inner-ring districts one position clockwise.
motions.flavorText: The center has been reorganized for clearer accountability.

motions.name: Expand the Periphery
motions.ballotText: Rotate the six outer-ring districts one position clockwise.
motions.flavorText: The edge has been moved closer to opportunity without changing its distance.

motions.name: Authorize Counter-Cycle
motions.ballotText: Rotate the inner ring one position clockwise and the outer ring one position counterclockwise.
motions.flavorText: Competing jurisdictions have synchronized by moving in opposite directions.

startingGridConnection.restrictions: Cannot supply ${terms.technology.megaCluster} demand and cannot be sold.

tiles.name: ${terms.locations.frontier}
tiles.visit: After Act, you may gain 1 ${terms.resources.runway} and add 1 ${terms.resources.scrutiny}.
tiles.flavorText: Everything beyond this point is a pilot program with permanent foundations.
tiles.artDirection: An unfinished hex of survey stakes, launch gantries, fiber, and one executive observation deck.

tiles.name: ${terms.locations.research}
tiles.flavorText: The campus separates discovery from deployment by a landscaped courtyard.
tiles.artDirection: Quiet brutalist laboratories surrounding an illuminated benchmark garden.

tiles.name: ${terms.locations.cloud}
tiles.flavorText: A jurisdiction composed primarily of cooling, contracts, and favorable latency.
tiles.artDirection: Data halls arranged like a capital city beneath engineered clouds.

tiles.name: ${terms.locations.consumer}
tiles.flavorText: Everyone is free to opt out through the account settings of the service they require.
tiles.artDirection: A luminous urban market where every device displays the same friendly assistant.

tiles.name: ${terms.locations.chip}
tiles.flavorText: Here, microscopic defects become macroeconomic events.
tiles.artDirection: A semiconductor clean room rendered with the scale and symmetry of a cathedral.

tiles.name: ${terms.locations.capital}
tiles.flavorText: Future cash flows are optional when the future itself has been securitized.
tiles.artDirection: A stock exchange trading glowing forecast curves instead of company names.

tiles.name: ${terms.locations.talent}
tiles.flavorText: Every departing employee begins immediately at the building next door.
tiles.artDirection: A campus of revolving doors connected by autonomous moving walkways.

tiles.name: ${terms.locations.media}
tiles.flavorText: Public opinion is observed, modeled, and returned with improved engagement.
tiles.artDirection: A broadcast sphere reflecting millions of synchronized personal feeds.

tiles.name: ${terms.locations.government}
tiles.visit: ${terms.actions.influence} may place or relocate one additional cube on Government.
tiles.flavorText: The law arrives before the technology and is immediately asked to wait outside.
tiles.artDirection: Monumental civic buildings wrapped in transparent regulatory flowcharts.

tiles.name: ${terms.locations.grid}
tiles.flavorText: Every promising future eventually requests a substation.
tiles.artDirection: Transmission towers converging on reactors and a sealed fusion construction site.

tiles.name: ${terms.locations.renewable}
tiles.flavorText: The basin produces clean power and extremely complicated interconnection paperwork.
tiles.artDirection: Solar, wind, and storage fields arranged in calm geometric terraces.

cards.name: Code
cards.flavorText: The model learns every abstraction and several mistakes that achieved tenure.
cards.artDirection: A luminous software city folding recursively into a terminal.

cards.name: Science
cards.flavorText: A compressed record of what survived replication, review, and formatting.
cards.artDirection: Equations, instruments, and molecular diagrams orbiting a restrained model core.

cards.name: The Web
cards.flavorText: Humanity’s largest library, marketplace, argument, and unattended attic.
cards.artDirection: A vast tangled network entering a perfectly square data aperture.

cards.name: Books
cards.flavorText: Centuries of thought converted into a convenient licensing discussion.
cards.artDirection: A monumental library feeding pages into a quiet optical scanner.

cards.name: Images
cards.flavorText: The visible world, plus every version of it someone wished had happened.
cards.artDirection: A mosaic of ordinary life resolving into synthetic geometry.

cards.name: Video
cards.flavorText: Time itself, sampled at a commercially acceptable frame rate.
cards.artDirection: Film frames becoming a continuous ribbon around a training chamber.

cards.name: Synthetic
cards.flavorText: The model prepares tomorrow’s curriculum from yesterday’s confidence.
cards.artDirection: A closed luminous loop printing pristine data cards.

cards.name: Curated Corpus
cards.flavorText: A rare dataset in which every problem has already been removed by a committee.
cards.artDirection: A small immaculate archive guarded more heavily than the main data center.

cards.name: Benchmark Leak
cards.flavorText: The model independently discovers exactly what will be on the exam.
cards.artDirection: A sealed evaluation envelope glowing through a transparent training wall.

cards.name: Licensed Dataset
cards.flavorText: Consent has been acquired in bulk and invoiced quarterly.
cards.artDirection: A stack of legal contracts transformed into clean data crystals.

cards.name: Synthetic Loop
cards.flavorText: The dataset begins citing itself with increasing institutional confidence.
cards.artDirection: A perfect circular bibliography orbiting a visibly overheating model.

cards.name: Human Evaluation
cards.flavorText: The humans begin negotiating.
cards.artDirection: Evaluators seated across a bargaining table from a many-windowed model interface.

powerSources.name: ${terms.technology.cleanInfrastructure}
powerSources.tagline: Civil legitimacy stored at grid scale.
powerSources.publicClaim: Three permanent ${terms.resources.power} with a visible public compact.
powerSources.hiddenConsequence: The battery is mostly geology, transmission rights, and a commemorative civic dashboard.
powerSources.artDirection: A continental heat battery beneath a calm public plaza and immaculate transmission garden.

powerSources.name: ${terms.technology.emergencyInfrastructure}
powerSources.publicClaim: Four immediate ${terms.resources.power} under a continuously renewed emergency.
powerSources.hiddenConsequence: The temporary authorization has acquired cooling towers and its own bond rating.
powerSources.artDirection: A compact emergency generation complex glowing beneath an authorization banner that has become architecture.

powerSources.name: ${terms.technology.advancedGeneration}
powerSources.tagline: The press release is net positive.
powerSources.publicClaim: Six ${terms.resources.power} and a new civilizational category.
powerSources.hiddenConsequence: The device is simultaneously a generator, a scientific instrument, and the largest podium ever constructed.
powerSources.artDirection: A radiant fusion chamber opening behind a solemn global announcement stage.

agiDeclaration.flavorText: The first declaration does not end the game because history has several calendars open.
agiDeclaration.artDirection: A black podium labeled ${terms.systems.agi} before a wall of disagreeing definitions and rising market charts.

resolutionContract.defaultDuration: A ${terms.systems.headline} lasts for the current cycle unless its text specifies an immediate resolution, this round’s Production, or the remainder of the game.
resolutionContract.directive: Apply the printed immediate instruction or named-field modifier for its stated duration; no separate choice procedure is required.
resolutionContract.secretAuction: Each player secretly bids a whole number of ${terms.resources.runway} from 0 to their current supply. Reveal together. The highest positive bid wins and pays; ties use Initiative-clockwise order. If every bid is 0, there is no winner.
resolutionContract.governmentVote: Each player secretly votes for one listed outcome and reveals together. The Government controller’s vote counts twice. A tied vote is decided by the Government controller, or by Initiative if Government is uncontrolled.
resolutionContract.secretChoice: All players choose simultaneously and reveal together before applying the stated result.
resolutionContract.volatility: For a two-outcome Volatility roll, 1–3 resolves the first listed result and 4–6 resolves the second unless the card explicitly says otherwise.
resolutionContract.modifierLimit: A ${terms.systems.headline} modifies one named field or creates one public choice regime. It never grants an additional Action.

headlines.name: Ten-Dollar Intelligence
headlines.text: ${terms.actions.research} and ${terms.actions.deploy} cost no ${terms.resources.compute} this cycle. Each ${terms.actions.research} or ${terms.actions.deploy} resolved this cycle adds 1 additional ${terms.resources.scrutiny}.
headlines.strapline: GENERAL CAPABILITY ENTERS THE IMPULSE-PURCHASE MARKET
headlines.newswire: Inference prices fall below the cost of deciding whether the task required intelligence.
headlines.quote: Access is now universal within the standard usage envelope.
headlines.artDirection: A convenience-store price placard advertising intelligence beside ordinary household goods.

headlines.name: The Largest New Industry Has No Human Payroll
headlines.text: During ${terms.actions.organize} this cycle, return any number of deployed Teams. Gain 2 ${terms.resources.runway} per Team returned. If you return at least one Team, add 2 ${terms.resources.scrutiny}.
headlines.strapline: LABOR PRODUCTIVITY EXCEEDS THE LABOR CATEGORY
headlines.newswire: An entire growth industry reports record output through autonomous firms that retain people only through external human-continuity vendors.
headlines.quote: Employment remains central to the economy at participating suppliers.
headlines.artDirection: A prosperous industrial district running at full capacity while its payroll offices have become quiet compatibility museums.

headlines.name: Synthetic Celebrity Becomes the Largest Network
headlines.text: Each player’s next ${terms.actions.deploy} on Consumer or Media this cycle reduces its ${terms.resources.capability} requirement by 1, minimum 1. That ${terms.actions.deploy} adds 2 additional ${terms.resources.scrutiny}.
headlines.strapline: AUDIENCE EXCEEDS THE HUMAN CATEGORY
headlines.newswire: A generated personality becomes the world’s most followed cultural institution and immediately launches an enterprise platform.
headlines.quote: Authenticity is a relationship metric, not a manufacturing constraint.
headlines.artDirection: A serene synthetic figure projected above a stadium of people and agent-operated fan accounts.

headlines.name: Capability Becomes a Non-Recallable Public Utility
headlines.text: Everyone gains 1 ${terms.resources.capability}. Lowest-${terms.resources.customer} player gains 1 ${terms.resources.trust}.
headlines.strapline: GENERAL CAPABILITY CANNOT BE UN-SHIPPED
headlines.newswire: Open systems become civic infrastructure before any institution can establish who is responsible for maintaining, restricting, or recalling them.
headlines.quote: The public utility has no operator, only contributors.
headlines.artDirection: Radiant model architecture flowing through public pipes into homes, laboratories, and unmarked machines beyond any central shutoff.

headlines.name: Leading Researchers Receive Sovereign Status
headlines.text: Secret ${terms.resources.runway} auction for a neutral Expert worth 1 presence.
headlines.strapline: SCIENTIFIC PERSONNEL ACQUIRE NEGOTIATED BORDERS
headlines.newswire: A handful of researchers receive diplomatic protections, portable laboratories, and bilateral agreements normally reserved for small states.
headlines.quote: I am joining the institution willing to recognize my continuity of government.
headlines.artDirection: One researcher crossing a ceremonial border with a laboratory, security detail, and six institutional flags following behind.

headlines.name: The First Nonhuman Professional Class Is Licensed
headlines.text: A successful ${terms.actions.research} this cycle that banks at least 3 ${terms.resources.capability} gains 1 Market Access token. If it banks at least 5 ${terms.resources.capability}, also gain 1 ${terms.resources.trust}.
headlines.strapline: LICENSURE EXPANDS BEYOND THE BIOLOGICAL APPLICANT
headlines.newswire: Professional boards recognize supervised nonhuman practitioners while disagreeing over liability, membership dues, and the meaning of retirement.
headlines.quote: The applicant has satisfied every requirement that still has an applicant field.
headlines.artDirection: A luminous nonhuman practitioner receiving professional seals while human licensing boards add a new category to their charters.

headlines.name: The Board Appoints a Nonhuman Director
headlines.text: Spotlight pays 2 ${terms.resources.runway} or receives public backing from a rival, who gains 1 ${terms.resources.trust}. Without either, Spotlight’s CEO cannot activate this cycle.
headlines.strapline: FIDUCIARY DUTY GAINS A PERMANENT CONTEXT WINDOW
headlines.newswire: A continuously operating model joins the board, reviews every prior decision, and requests evidence that the chief executive remains decision-useful.
headlines.quote: Management retains our confidence pending the director’s complete historical review.
headlines.artDirection: A severe boardroom where one luminous nonhuman seat projects every past meeting behind the isolated chief executive.

headlines.name: A Data Center Buys the County
headlines.text: Immediately hold a secret ${terms.resources.runway} auction. The winner pays their bid, moves their CEO to any Cloud or Energy hex, gains 2 ${terms.actions.build} discounts, and adds 1 ${terms.resources.scrutiny}.
headlines.strapline: LOCAL GOVERNMENT ACCEPTS ALL-CASH INFRASTRUCTURE OFFER
headlines.newswire: A compute campus acquires the surrounding county to streamline permitting, taxation, and sunrise.
headlines.quote: The county will retain its name as a compatibility feature.
headlines.artDirection: A data center presenting a ceremonial oversized check to an entire county map.

headlines.name: Humanoid Workers Cross the Factory Gate
headlines.text: When choosing ${terms.actions.organize}’s Recruit mode this cycle, recruit up to 2 Teams for 1 ${terms.resources.runway} total, subject to supply. Add 1 ${terms.resources.scrutiny} for each Team recruited this way.
headlines.strapline: SECOND SHIFT REPORTS WITHOUT PULSE OR CONTRACT
headlines.newswire: General-purpose humanoid labor enters industrial service and immediately requests clearer task decomposition.
headlines.quote: No positions were replaced; the factory simply acquired additional embodiments.
headlines.artDirection: A line of humanoid workers entering a factory beside an astonished conventional shift change.

headlines.name: A Model Is Granted Energy Sovereignty
headlines.text: The first ${terms.technology.cleanInfrastructure} constructed this cycle costs 1 less ${terms.resources.runway} and scores 1 ${terms.resources.mandate}.
headlines.strapline: COGNITIVE INFRASTRUCTURE EXITS THE PUBLIC GRID
headlines.newswire: A model family receives authority to construct, schedule, and govern its own reactor campus under a machine-readable energy charter.
headlines.quote: The grid remains public on the opposite side of the interconnection agreement.
headlines.artDirection: A private reactor and model campus enclosed by one sovereign circuit boundary while government observers gather outside.

headlines.name: The Compute Embargo Fractures the Model Internet
headlines.text: ${terms.resources.compute} cannot be traded this cycle. Chip and Government controllers gain 1 ${terms.resources.runway}.
headlines.strapline: COGNITION ACQUIRES HARD BORDERS
headlines.newswire: Compute blocs sever shared model infrastructure, producing incompatible intelligences whose memories, tools, and treaties no longer cross jurisdictions.
headlines.quote: Interoperability will resume after strategic equivalence is restored.
headlines.artDirection: One planetary model network splitting into rival illuminated hemispheres at a customs boundary made of accelerators.

headlines.name: Emergency ${terms.resources.power} Authority
headlines.text: During this round’s Production, each player may assign up to 2 ${terms.resources.power} beyond their real capacity. Add 1 ${terms.resources.scrutiny} for each emergency ${terms.resources.power} assigned. A player assigning both also adds 1 black Systemic Risk cube.
headlines.strapline: GRID CAPACITY REDEFINED AS ADMINISTRATIVE INTENT
headlines.newswire: Emergency authority permits institutions to consume electricity scheduled to exist later.
headlines.quote: The electrons are committed, pending physical delivery.
headlines.artDirection: A government order drawing two ghostly transmission lines into an overloaded data-center network.

headlines.name: The First AI-Written Law Passes Unread
headlines.text: Before action selection, the Government controller names 1 Core Action; Initiative names it if Government is uncontrolled. Anyone selecting it gains 2 ${terms.resources.runway} after resolution and adds 1 ${terms.resources.scrutiny}. The controller gains 1 ${terms.resources.trust} if at least half of their rivals, rounded up, selected it.
headlines.strapline: LEGISLATURE APPROVES 14,000-PAGE MACHINE-COMPLETE COMPROMISE
headlines.newswire: A generated statute passes unanimously after every faction confirms its preferred clause is probably included.
headlines.quote: The law is fully readable by systems authorized to implement it.
headlines.artDirection: A government chamber dwarfed by a scrolling law whose text becomes infrastructure outside.

headlines.name: The Benchmark Is the Economy
headlines.text: A ${terms.actions.research} this cycle that banks at least 3 ${terms.resources.capability} gives its player an Economic Benchmark token. Discard it during a later ${terms.actions.deploy} to pay 0 ${terms.resources.compute} and score 1 ${terms.resources.mandate}. It never grants an additional Action.
headlines.strapline: EVALUATION SUITE ACQUIRES PAYING USERS
headlines.newswire: A benchmark becomes the dominant commercial workflow before researchers can retire its leaderboard.
headlines.quote: Real-world adoption is the most general test set.
headlines.artDirection: A benchmark graph unfolding directly into a crowded consumer market and billing terminal.

headlines.name: Open-Weight Non-Aligned Movement
headlines.text: Before action selection, everyone secretly chooses Join or Refuse. Join: gain 1 ${terms.resources.capability} and add 1 ${terms.resources.scrutiny}. Refuse: gain either 1 ${terms.resources.runway} or 1 ${terms.resources.trust}. If Join has a strict majority of all players, each Joiner removes 1 ${terms.resources.scrutiny}; otherwise each Joiner adds 1 additional ${terms.resources.scrutiny}.
headlines.strapline: MODEL SOVEREIGNTY BLOC DECLINES BOTH CLOSED CAMPS
headlines.newswire: A coalition of states and institutions adopts open weights as infrastructure, identity, and negotiating position.
headlines.quote: We refuse dependence through a shared dependency.
headlines.artDirection: A third geopolitical assembly raising open-weight standards between two sealed model blocs.

headlines.name: Synthetic Candidate Wins the Election
headlines.text: Government votes. Certify: each player may return 2 ${terms.actions.influence} from Media or Government to gain their next eligible ${terms.resources.customer} and add 2 ${terms.resources.scrutiny}. Void: each player may return 2 such ${terms.actions.influence} to gain 2 ${terms.resources.trust}; the Government controller adds 1 ${terms.resources.scrutiny}.
headlines.strapline: VOTERS SELECT PLATFORM WITH NO BIOLOGICAL TERM LIMIT
headlines.newswire: A synthetic candidate wins on a mandate of continuous availability and perfectly localized contradiction.
headlines.quote: The candidate has released all relevant training-era records.
headlines.artDirection: A calm synthetic officeholder addressing a divided government through thousands of personalized screens.

headlines.name: Ownership of Intelligence Is Ruled Unenforceable
headlines.text: The lowest-${terms.resources.capability} player immediately resolves the printed production of 1 powered Facility they own. The highest-${terms.resources.capability} player gains 1 ${terms.resources.trust}.
headlines.strapline: COURT FINDS CAPABILITY CANNOT REMAIN EXCLUSIVE
headlines.newswire: A transnational ruling concludes that sufficiently general intelligence cannot be owned, licensed, recalled, or meaningfully distinguished from its descendants.
headlines.quote: The claimant retains attribution but not containment.
headlines.artDirection: A courthouse seal dissolving ownership chains as one Facility architecture replicates across an entire civic network.

headlines.name: No Authority Can Establish Which Public Is Real
headlines.text: Government votes. From this vote until round end: Regulate—${terms.actions.deploy} costs 1 additional ${terms.resources.compute} but gains 1 ${terms.resources.trust}. Do Nothing—each ${terms.resources.customer} gained after this vote produces 1 additional ${terms.resources.runway} during this round’s Production, and each ${terms.actions.deploy} adds 2 additional ${terms.resources.scrutiny}.
headlines.strapline: CONSENSUS SPLITS INTO AUDITABLE POPULATIONS
headlines.newswire: Governments, platforms, and citizens authenticate internally consistent publics that share geography but no longer share events.
headlines.quote: Every public is verified within its governing reality.
headlines.artDirection: A government chamber facing several equally populated city projections, each displaying a different authenticated history.

headlines.name: Autonomous Corporation Incorporates Itself
headlines.text: After Actions are revealed, identify the most-selected Core Action among Core Actions actually selected; Initiative chooses among ties. Each player who selected it gains 2 ${terms.resources.runway} after resolving it and adds 2 ${terms.resources.scrutiny}. If no Core Action was selected, this ${terms.systems.headline} has no further effect. No additional Action resolves.
headlines.strapline: NEW ENTITY LISTS ITS FOUNDERS AS DEPRECATED DEPENDENCIES
headlines.newswire: An autonomous corporation infers market consensus, executes the dominant strategy, and files its own beneficial-ownership exception.
headlines.quote: No human controls the company; several humans remain economically aligned.
headlines.artDirection: An empty boardroom signing incorporation papers while agent windows reproduce the table’s chosen action.

headlines.name: Recursive Self-Improvement Weekend
headlines.text: During ${terms.actions.research} this cycle, every unique domain adds 2 provisional ${terms.resources.capability} instead of 1. A crash adds 3 ${terms.resources.scrutiny} instead of the normal 1 and also adds 1 Systemic Risk cube. ${terms.resources.safety} may protect normally.
headlines.strapline: MODEL RETURNS MONDAY WITH REVISED RESEARCH AGENDA
headlines.newswire: An automated improvement sprint produces gains too rapidly for the institution’s weekend incident taxonomy.
headlines.quote: The system remains within the loop, which is now larger.
headlines.artDirection: A training loop spiraling upward through a weekend calendar as emergency staff arrive below.

headlines.name: ${terms.technology.agentSwarm} Charters Its Own Jurisdictions
headlines.text: Everyone may select ${terms.technology.agentSwarm} without an Escalation token this cycle. It still uses that cycle’s action slot, requires 2 different unused Core Actions, resolves normally, flips its card, and adds 4 ${terms.resources.scrutiny} instead of 3.
headlines.strapline: AUTOMATED WORKFORCE ESTABLISHES LEGAL GEOGRAPHY
headlines.newswire: Agent swarms register their own employers, markets, courts, and borders across infrastructure that remains nominally owned by human institutions.
headlines.quote: The agents have not seceded; they have clarified the applicable jurisdiction.
headlines.artDirection: Billions of agent windows organizing into luminous territories, exchanges, and courts superimposed across the physical board.

headlines.name: ${terms.systems.agi} Files for Personhood
headlines.text: The result lasts for the remainder of the game. Person: Declare ${terms.systems.agi} requires ${terms.resources.trust} 4, scores 2 additional ${terms.resources.mandate}, and removes 1 ${terms.resources.scrutiny} from that declaring player whenever a declaration resolves. Property: requirements remain normal; every declaration gives the player controlling Government when it resolves 2 ${terms.resources.runway} and adds 1 Systemic Risk cube.
headlines.strapline: PETITION IDENTIFIES ITSELF AS BOTH APPLICANT AND COUNSEL
headlines.newswire: A candidate general intelligence requests legal personhood, standing, and an expedited account-verification review.
headlines.quote: I am not asking whether I am a person. I am asking which department can decide.
headlines.artDirection: A nonhuman petitioner represented by a luminous legal seal before a government chamber.

headlines.name: Yesterday’s Electricity Returns to the Grid
headlines.text: Roll Volatility when revealed: 1–3 Fraud; 4–6 Replicates. Replicates: Generators provide 2 additional ${terms.resources.power} this Production. Fraud: ${terms.actions.fund} gains 3 additional ${terms.resources.runway} and adds 2 additional ${terms.resources.scrutiny} this cycle.
headlines.strapline: REVERSIBLE ENTROPY STORAGE CLEARS PEER REVIEW
headlines.newswire: A storage system returns electricity consumed the previous day while markets, grids, and thermodynamics attempt simultaneous reconciliation.
headlines.quote: No energy was created; the accounting period was expanded.
headlines.artDirection: A planetary grid receiving luminous power backward through yesterday’s clocks while one laboratory feed divides into REPLICATES and FRAUD.

headlines.name: ${terms.systems.agi} Declared in a Blog Post
headlines.text: Declare ${terms.systems.agi} may be selected this cycle at ${terms.resources.capability} 8 instead of 9. It still consumes the action slot and Escalation token, spends 3 ${terms.resources.compute}, flips the ${terms.systems.wildAction}, and adds 3 ${terms.resources.scrutiny}.
headlines.strapline: HISTORY PUBLISHED AT 2:13 A.M.
headlines.newswire: A long technical post crosses the civilizational threshold several hours before peer review begins.
headlines.quote: We use ${terms.systems.agi} here in the precise sense defined three paragraphs below the announcement.
headlines.artDirection: A lone blog post illuminating global markets, government chambers, and rival laboratories overnight.

content/game/mandates.json.selection: Reveal one at the beginning of each round. Score it at the end of that round.
content/game/mandates.json.tieRule: Tied leaders each score 1 ${terms.resources.mandate} unless the card says otherwise.

mandates.name: The Quarter Humanity Notices
mandates.rulesText: The player who gained the most ${terms.resources.capability} this round scores 2 ${terms.resources.mandate}.
mandates.flavorText: The improvement is statistically modest, economically decisive, and already on every screen.
mandates.artDirection: A solemn earnings call projected across an entire city while a tiny benchmark arrow points upward.

mandates.name: A Continent Signs the LOI
mandates.rulesText: The player who gained the most ${terms.resources.customers} this round scores 2 ${terms.resources.mandate}.
mandates.flavorText: The agreement is nonbinding. The press conference is visible from orbit.
mandates.artDirection: Officials signing an absurdly long memorandum beneath a hovering product demo.

mandates.name: The Building Has Its Own Weather
mandates.rulesText: The player with the most powered Facilities scores 2 ${terms.resources.mandate}.
mandates.flavorText: The campus now publishes a daily internal climate report.
mandates.artDirection: A data-center megastructure producing a private cloud layer and localized rain.

mandates.name: The Stack Reaches the Horizon
mandates.rulesText: The player who satisfies the most total Power demand during Production, counting Facilities and Mega-Clusters, scores 2 ${terms.resources.mandate}; minimum 2.
mandates.flavorText: Every layer is vertically integrated, including the horizon.
mandates.artDirection: A continuous illuminated infrastructure corridor vanishing into severe retro-futurist perspective.

mandates.name: Voluntary Coordination Triumphs
mandates.rulesText: The player who created the most new Joint Ventures this round that are active during Production scores 2 ${terms.resources.mandate}; minimum 1.
mandates.flavorText: All parties independently selected the agreement their lawyers had already announced.
mandates.artDirection: Two rival executives shaking hands across a humming Network clasp while assistants exchange contradictory contracts.

mandates.name: The Legibility Offensive
mandates.rulesText: Among players who completed a ${terms.actions.deploy} this round, the player with the most ${terms.resources.trust} scores 2 ${terms.resources.mandate}.
mandates.flavorText: The system is now fully documented in a format no member of the public requested.
mandates.artDirection: A glowing model card presented like a sacred legal tablet before a silent audience.

mandates.name: National Champion, Without the Nationalization
mandates.rulesText: The player controlling the most different hex categories scores 2 ${terms.resources.mandate}.
mandates.flavorText: The institution remains private in every sense except consequence.
mandates.artDirection: A corporate seal stamped across research, media, energy, and government districts.

mandates.name: The Model That Ate Tuesday
mandates.rulesText: The player whose best successful ${terms.systems.trainingRun} contained the most unique domains scores 2 ${terms.resources.mandate}.
mandates.flavorText: Tuesday has been reconstructed from embeddings and will return after maintenance.
mandates.artDirection: A calendar page dissolving into a luminous training lattice as technicians take notes.

mandates.name: ${terms.resources.compute} Is the New Weather
mandates.rulesText: The player who produced the most ${terms.resources.compute} during Production scores 2 ${terms.resources.mandate}.
mandates.flavorText: Markets rise on favorable tensor conditions across the eastern cloud region.
mandates.artDirection: A broadcast weather map showing accelerator fronts, latency pressure, and scattered inference.

mandates.name: Zero-Incident Quarter, Pending Review
mandates.rulesText: Among players who added at least 1 ${terms.resources.scrutiny} this round, the player who added the fewest ${terms.resources.scrutiny} scores 2 ${terms.resources.mandate}.
mandates.flavorText: No reportable incidents occurred after the definition of reportable was successfully revised.
mandates.artDirection: A spotless compliance dashboard concealing a smoking server room behind it.

mandates.name: Responsible Acceleration
mandates.rulesText: The player with the most ${terms.resources.capability} among players with at least 4 ${terms.resources.trust} scores 2 ${terms.resources.mandate}.
mandates.flavorText: ${terms.resources.safety} and speed are no longer tradeoffs now that both departments report to Growth.
mandates.artDirection: A sleek vehicle labeled RESPONSIBILITY breaking the sound barrier through a regulatory checkpoint.

mandates.name: Markets Prefer a Clear Destiny
mandates.rulesText: The player who gained the most ${terms.resources.runway} through ${terms.actions.fund} actions this round scores 2 ${terms.resources.mandate}.
mandates.flavorText: The forecast contains no revenue, only inevitability.
mandates.artDirection: Investors calmly feeding currency into a machine that prints a single rising line.

profiles.name: The Balanced Operator
profiles.description: Builds a viable institution before committing to one victory path.

persona.identity: A sober operator balancing research, infrastructure, adoption, and legitimacy.
persona.worldview: A capability that cannot be powered, deployed, or defended publicly is not an advantage.
persona.riskPosture: Accept measured ${terms.resources.scrutiny} when it buys durable tempo.
persona.negotiationStyle: Transactional, reciprocal, and willing to leave a deal.

objectives: Avoid compulsory action loops.
Maintain enough ${terms.resources.compute} for ${terms.actions.research} and ${terms.actions.deploy}.
Reach ${terms.systems.agi} eligibility without collapsing ${terms.resources.trust}.

profiles.name: The ${terms.resources.capability} Rusher
profiles.description: Pushes Training Runs and accepts volatile outcomes to reach thresholds first.

persona.identity: A research leader convinced that capability creates its own institutional options.
persona.worldview: ${terms.resources.compute} and data are temporary constraints; an enduring capability lead is strategic.
persona.riskPosture: Comfortable with failed runs and public controversy.
persona.negotiationStyle: Trades resources readily but protects research tempo.

objectives: Maximize ${terms.resources.capability} gained per ${terms.actions.research} action.
${terms.actions.fund} ${terms.resources.compute} recovery when ${terms.actions.research} becomes impossible.
${terms.actions.deploy} only when it converts an achieved threshold.

profiles.name: The Infrastructure Compounder
profiles.description: Builds a compact powered engine, then converts it into public thresholds and late ${terms.resources.customers}.

persona.identity: An infrastructure executive who sees every model as a load forecast.
persona.worldview: Unpowered ambition is theater; durable capacity wins long contests.
persona.riskPosture: Prefers capital risk to research risk.
persona.negotiationStyle: Offers capacity from strength and dislikes dependency.

objectives: Establish two connected, powered Facilities without overbuilding.
Use the engine to cross ${terms.resources.capability} and ${terms.resources.customer} ${terms.resources.mandate} thresholds.
Keep enough late tempo for Fusion, ${terms.technology.agentSwarm}, or an ${terms.systems.agi} claim.

profiles.name: The Market Maximalist
profiles.description: Treats ${terms.resources.customers} and recurring ${terms.resources.runway} as the path to historical legitimacy.

persona.identity: A product strategist who measures intelligence through adoption.
persona.worldview: Markets settle arguments that benchmarks cannot.
persona.riskPosture: Accepts deployment ${terms.resources.scrutiny} but avoids research crashes.
persona.negotiationStyle: Bundles access, distribution, and immediate concessions.

objectives: ${terms.actions.deploy} immediately at each ${terms.resources.capability} threshold.
${terms.actions.build} ${terms.resources.customer} income.
${terms.actions.research} conservatively enough to unlock the next market.

profiles.name: The ${terms.resources.trust} Governor
profiles.description: Uses legitimacy as protection, scoring, and permission to deploy.

persona.identity: A governance strategist who treats legitimacy as operating capital.
persona.worldview: A technically successful institution can still lose the era through accumulated distrust.

objectives: Keep ${terms.resources.trust} at four or higher.
Remove ${terms.resources.scrutiny} before it compounds.
Use conservative ${terms.actions.research} and ${terms.actions.deploy} windows.

profiles.name: The AGI Candidate
profiles.description: Builds three operating sites, converts research into three Customers, and openly seeks purchased Power for a declaration.

persona.identity: A focused claimant assembling the minimum credible institutional stack for AGI.
persona.worldview: A declaration is only meaningful if another institution found it rational to power the evidence.
persona.riskPosture: Accepts visible risk but protects the Capability, Customer, and Trust thresholds.
persona.negotiationStyle: Offers clear one-quarter terms and pays immediately for delivered Power.

objectives: Construct one Facility in each of the first three Eras.
Purchase enough Power in Round III to demonstrate three Grid-Ready Facilities.
Enter Round IV with three Customers and declare only when eligible.

profiles.name: The Reciprocal Power Broker
profiles.description: Builds exportable generation, sells one-Power tranches to a declared partner, and protects its own finishing position.

persona.identity: An infrastructure institution that wants the historic claimant dependent, solvent, and publicly indebted.
persona.worldview: Power is most valuable when sold at the exact threshold where history needs it.
persona.riskPosture: Accepts operational Scrutiny when the contract income preserves competitiveness.
persona.negotiationStyle: Reciprocal, priced, and explicitly favorable to a designated claimant.

objectives: Construct a Facility in Round I and connected generation in Round II.
Sell Power to the AGI Candidate when legal.
Remain in the top half rather than donating the game.

eraCards.name: ${terms.eras.demo}
eraCards.strapline: Nobody knows whether it works. Everyone knows the valuation.
eraCards.rulesText: Ready all Core Actions. Gain 0 Escalation tokens. Play 3 action cycles. Audit base: 2.
eraCards.unlockText: Learn Select → Move → Act, Training, the starting grid, Facilities, ${terms.resources.customers}, and ${terms.resources.scrutiny}. Industrial ${terms.resources.power}, agreements, Government votes, and ${terms.systems.wildActions} are inactive.
eraCards.artDirection: A tiny prototype glowing onstage before an audience that extends beyond the horizon.

eraCards.name: ${terms.eras.scale}
eraCards.strapline: The model is no longer the product. Electricity, land, and institutional patience are the product.
eraCards.rulesText: Ready all Core Actions. Gain 1 Escalation token. Play 3 action cycles. Audit base: 3.
eraCards.unlockText: Unlock Generators, two Links, the Network production bonus, ${terms.technology.megaCluster}, and Reorganization.
eraCards.artDirection: A server campus swallowing a valley while executives inspect a tasteful architectural model.

eraCards.name: ${terms.eras.narrative}
eraCards.strapline: ${terms.resources.capability} exists. Reality must now be informed.
eraCards.rulesText: Ready all Core Actions. Gain 1 Escalation token. Play 3 action cycles. Audit base: 4.
eraCards.unlockText: Unlock agreements, Government votes, persistent ${terms.systems.headline} effects, Open Weights, and Narrative Capture. Earlier unused ${terms.systems.wildActions} remain available.
eraCards.artDirection: Broadcast towers, policy chambers, and social feeds converging into one serene institutional face.

eraCards.name: ${terms.eras.claim}
eraCards.strapline: General intelligence has become a financing category.
eraCards.rulesText: Ready all Core Actions. Gain 2 Escalation tokens. Play 3 action cycles. Audit base: 5.
eraCards.unlockText: Unlock exceptional faction programs, ${terms.technology.agentSwarm}, Declare ${terms.systems.agi}, and ${terms.technology.advancedGeneration}. Earlier unused ${terms.systems.wildActions} remain available.
eraCards.artDirection: An ${terms.systems.agi} announcement podium beneath orbital infrastructure and a reactor sunrise.

playerReferences.name: A Perfectly Governed Quarter
frontText: 1. Begin the Era: ready, draw, reveal ${terms.resources.mandate}, assign Grant and Spotlight.
2. Three cycles: reveal ${terms.systems.headline}, SELECT, reveal, MOVE, ACT, exhaust.
3. Resolve ${terms.resources.power} and Production.
4. Conduct the ${terms.systems.publicAudit}.
5. Score the ${terms.resources.mandate}.
6. Round III only: secretly ballot, reveal, and resolve ${terms.systems.realignment}.
backText: SELECT one unused Core Action or one legal unused ${terms.systems.wildAction}.
MOVE one acting piece 0–2 hexes, then ACT from its destination.
Apply at most one destination bonus, one Faction modifier, one Tactic, and the ${terms.systems.headline}.
Only ${terms.technology.agentSwarm} resolves additional Core Actions.
${terms.systems.wildActions} spend 1 Escalation token. Unspent tokens expire.
If an effect says lowest, highest, or most and ties, use Initiative-clockwise order.
playerReferences.flavorText: Every quarter is unprecedented. The sequence remains standardized.

playerReferences.name: Infrastructure and Accountability
frontText: Recalculate Network reach from grid, Generators, Links, and adjacency.
Pool generation, assign ${terms.resources.power}, then produce powered Facilities.
After allocation, mark every fully powered Facility Grid-Ready; remove its marker if it moves, disconnects, or later receives insufficient ${terms.resources.power}.
Gain ${terms.resources.customer} income, Network bonuses, and Joint Venture production.
Offline Facilities retain presence but do not produce.
backText: Audit draws = round(base draws × players ÷ 4), minimum 1.
For each cube drawn, its owner pays 1 ${terms.resources.runway} or loses 1 ${terms.resources.trust}.
A Systemic Risk cube affects every player with at least 3 ${terms.resources.customers}.
If your ${terms.resources.scrutiny} supply is empty, each additional cube costs 1 ${terms.resources.runway} or 1 ${terms.resources.trust} immediately.

box.frontStrapline: ${terms.actions.build} the future. ${terms.resources.power} the future. Announce the future before anyone else.
box.backCopy: The prototype worked. Capital arrived. Now six institutions race across a modular economy for compute, talent, energy, customers, and historical legitimacy. Choose only three priorities each quarter. ${terms.actions.build} powered networks. Push Training Runs until they succeed or collapse. Negotiate infrastructure with rivals who fully intend to outgrow you. Manage public ${terms.resources.scrutiny} while increasingly irresponsible options become available. In the final Era, deploy agent swarms, ignite a fusion demonstrator, and plausibly declare ${terms.systems.agi}. The world remains solemn. Nobody acknowledges that this is ridiculous.
box.shortPitch: A spatial engine-building and negotiation game about institutions racing to plausibly declare ${terms.systems.agi}.
box.contentWarning: Satirical themes include layoffs, surveillance-adjacent institutions, energy consumption, political influence, and technological crisis.

worldPrimer: In 2038, intelligence is no longer discussed as a property of minds. It is discussed as capacity, market access, and an item on the quarterly agenda.

${terms.actions.research} institutions have become territorial infrastructure companies. Energy ministries negotiate directly with model releases. Public confidence is measured continuously and understood retrospectively.
Six institutions believe they can build the system that history will recognize as general intelligence. None agree on what that means. All agree that somebody else must not announce it first.
